newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil flat, barges trade $89-$91 fob.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil flat, barges trade $89-$91 fob.

text.p: NWE high sulphur cracked fuel oil was stable on Monday and bunker demand had subsided, traders said.
High sulphur barges traded at $89 fob ARA for prompt stored material but deals were also done at $90.50, $90.75 and $91 a tonne.
High sulphur cargoes were also steady although trade was thin.
Low sulphur cargoes were pegged stable. A low sulphur cargo was heard sold at $95 fob NWE on Thursday but this deal could not be confirmed.
Low sulphur straight-run markets were calm after deals this week at around $107 a tonne fob NWE for cargoes containing around 0.6 percent sulphur, and above $108 fob for 0.4-0.5 percent sulphur.
